title: Orientation Test
summary: A short entry gate that checks the patient can operate a tablet before the main cognitive tests.
description:
Sometimes a low score reflects unfamiliarity with tablets rather than cognitive decline.

This short "entry gate" asks for about seven very simple actions — dragging a shape, drawing a line, pressing buttons — to confirm the patient can operate the device before the main tests.

## Status
The orientation test completed a trial with **more than 50 patients**, including a pilot at Protea in the Village. In the unified [Digital Cognitive Test Battery](/projects/digital-cognitive-tests) it is the first module, routing the patient to the next tests.
